```{r doublets}
library(scDblFinder)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

for (i in 1:length(Disease.list)) {
  
  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(Disease.list[[i]])
  sce <- scDblFinder(sce)
  
  Disease.list[[i]]$scDblFinder.class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
  Disease.list[[i]]$scDblFinder.score <- sce$scDblFinder.score
  
  Disease.list[[i]] <- subset(Disease.list[[i]], scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
  
  # show progress
  message(paste("Finished processing sample", i, "of", length(Disease.list)))
}

```



```{r Scaling data}
AAA_Ctrl_Merged <- RunPCA(AAA_Ctrl_Merged, npcs = 12, features = VariableFeatures(object = AAA_Ctrl_Merged))
```

```{r Integration}
AAA_Ctrl_Merged<- IntegrateLayers(AAA_Ctrl_Merged, method = FastMNNIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.mnn", verbose = FALSE)
```
```{r Find clusters}
AAA_Ctrl_Merged <- FindNeighbors(AAA_Ctrl_Merged, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:12)
AAA_Ctrl_Merged <- FindClusters(AAA_Ctrl_Merged, resolution = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5), verbose = FALSE)
```

# Anntotate the Global Clusters
```{r}
fun <- function(x) {
  if (x == "0") {"VSMCs"} 
  else if (x == "1") {"Macrophages"}
  else if (x == "2") {"T_cells"}
  else if (x == "3") {"B_cells"}
  else if (x == "4") {"Endothelial_cells"}
  else if (x == "5") {"Fibroblasts"}
  else if (x == "6") {"Epithelial"}
  else if (x == "7") {"Plasma_cells"}
  else if (x == "8") {"Neutrophils"}
}
AAA_Ctrl_Merged$cell.type <- mapply(fun, AAA_Ctrl_Merged$RNA_snn_res.0.1)
```

```{r Dimplot}
Distribution_normalized_reversed<-ClusterDistrBar(AAA_Ctrl_Merged$class, AAA_Ctrl_Merged$cell.type, cols = c("grey", "royalblue4", "maroon"), border = "black", normalize = TRUE, rev = TRUE)+ theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
ggsave(Distribution_normalized_reversed,file=paste(fig,"Distribution_normalized_reversed_Wahidi.png"),width =5,height = 3)
```

```{r}
fun <- function(x) {
  if (x == "Macrophages") {"Macrophages"} 
  else if (x == "T_cells") {"T_cells"}
  else if (x == "B_cells") {"B_cells"}
  else if (x == "VSMCs") {"VSMC_Fibro"}
  else if (x == "Endothelial_cells") {"Endothelial_cells"}
  else if (x == "Plasma_cells") {"Plasma_cells"}
  else if (x == "Fibroblasts") {"VSMC_Fibro"}
  else if (x == "Neutrophils") {"Neutrophils"}
}
AAA_Ctrl_Merged$cell.type2 <- mapply(fun, AAA_Ctrl_Merged$cell.type)
```

```{r readobject}
vsmcFibro<- readRDS("/storage1/fs1/zayedm/Active/Human_AAAs/R_Markdowns/vsmcFibro_subset_nodoub.rds")
```

```{r Clustering}
vsmcFibro <- FindNeighbors(vsmcFibro, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:12)
vsmcFibro <- FindClusters(vsmcFibro, resolution = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5), verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r merge and name subsetted clusters}
Idents(vsmcFibro) = "RNA_snn_res.0.1"
vsmcFibro <- RenameIdents(vsmcFibro, '3' = "2")

vsmcFibro$RNA_snn_res.0.1 <- factor(Idents(vsmcFibro), levels = c("0", "2", "1", "4"))
```

```{r Gene Ontology Analysis}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

vsmcFibro.Markers <- FindAllMarkers(vsmcFibro, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

###get each individual clusters markers
Cluster0.markers <- vsmcFibro.Markers[vsmcFibro.Markers$cluster==0 & vsmcFibro.Markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
Cluster1.markers <- vsmcFibro.Markers[vsmcFibro.Markers$cluster==1 & vsmcFibro.Markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
Cluster2.markers <- vsmcFibro.Markers[vsmcFibro.Markers$cluster==2 & vsmcFibro.Markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
Cluster3.markers <- vsmcFibro.Markers[vsmcFibro.Markers$cluster==3 & vsmcFibro.Markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]

###convert to different format
Cluster0.genes <- bitr(Cluster0.markers$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
Cluster1.genes <- bitr(Cluster1.markers$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
Cluster2.genes <- bitr(Cluster2.markers$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
Cluster3.genes <- bitr(Cluster3.markers$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

cluster_lists <- split(vsmcFibro.Markers$gene, vsmcFibro.Markers$cluster)

cluster_lists <- lapply(cluster_lists, function(genes) {
  gene_ids <- bitr(genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
  return(gene_ids$ENTREZID)
})


###comparative analysis
go_compare_bp <- compareCluster(geneCluster = cluster_lists, 
    fun = "enrichGO", 
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
    ont = "BP",  # "BP", "MF" or "CC"
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.05)


GOPlot <- dotplot(go_compare_bp, showCategory = 4,
              title = "VSMC and Fibroblast Subclustering")
GOPlot + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave(GOPlot,file=paste(fig,"CC_Updated_GO_VSMC_Fibro.pdf"),width =6,height = 8)


```

```{test vsmcFibro Recluster}

vsmcFibro <- NormalizeData(vsmcFibro, verbose = FALSE)
vsmcFibro <- FindVariableFeatures(vsmcFibro, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
head(VariableFeatures(vsmcFibro), 10)
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(vsmcFibro), 10)
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(vsmcFibro)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
ggsave(plot2,file=paste(fig,"Top10genes_Vftplot.pdf",sep=""),width=10,height=10)

all.genes <- rownames(vsmcFibro)
vsmcFibro <- ScaleData(vsmcFibro, features = all.genes)
vsmcFibro <- RunPCA(vsmcFibro, npcs = 12, features = VariableFeatures(object = vsmcFibro))

vsmcFibro <- RunUMAP(vsmcFibro, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:12,seed.use = 42)
vsmcFibro <- RunTSNE(vsmcFibro, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:12)

newMap <- DimPlot2(vsmcFibro, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1", pt.size = 0.5)
```
